description: How copies enter. limit (default for new accounts): a post-only order at the leader's price; unfilled after 1 minute, it is cancelled and the copy opens at market unless the price is more than 1% from the leader's entry; if the leader exits first, nothing is copied (limit_missed event). market: at market right away, skipped if the price is more than 1% from the leader's entry. Orders already waiting keep their mode.
name: set_order_mode
title: Market or limit entries
